# [EPIC] Autonomous SDLC system — Scrum backlog, quality gates, branching, scheduling

## Epic
Turn this repo's tooling into a mostly-autonomous SDLC loop: Scrum-shaped backlog (Epic -> Story -> Task), enforced quality gates, develop->main branching with issue-linked commits, and a scheduled routine that works the backlog unattended. Meant to later become a reusable plugin for other stacks/projects.

## Business Value
Without this, backlog and process rigor depend on a human staying involved every session. This is what lets the scheduled routine work unattended without drifting from what "done" means.

## Product Goal alignment
Indirectly serves the [Product Goal](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/PRODUCT_GOAL.md) by enforcing the process discipline its "defend in a technical interview" bar depends on — not a product feature Epic itself.

## Status
- Foundational templates, process docs, CLAUDE.md rules, git hooks, develop branch, and the scheduled routine are built and running (#75).
- Backlog #1-71 retrofitted with the Story layer and historical Sprints; commit history rewritten to match (#75).
- All acceptance criteria verified and Story #75 closed.
- Future enhancements (architecture-writing automation, cross-stack playbooks, reusable plugin extraction) can be scoped as new Stories when prioritized.
